steps.description:
- After entering **Prague**, make your way all the way to the north end of town and talk to the **Silent Peddler**.
- He is now selling items, and man, are they **good**!
- If you have some extra cash built up, you may want to stock up on each of the Mana and **Pure Extracts**, but not **Thera Extracts**; you can get those for 100 steps apiece with the **Pedometer** Service.
- You may also want to take the opportunity to get some **Third Keys**; they can make some boss battles go by WAY quicker if a beefed-up **Yuri** hits all 9 areas. :-D

notes.title: Note
notes.text: Make sure **Alice** is in your party, otherwise **Runaway Ewan** won't tell you about the **Dollhouse**.

steps.description:
1. After shopping, make your way to the bar and talk to **Runaway Ewan**, who's just below the Owner and **Yuria**; he'll tell you about a possessed house, and asks that you exorcise it.
2. By talking to him, we've now opened a new area of the **World Map**: the **Dollhouse**.
3. Leave **Prague**, then head into the **Dollhouse**.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: You should probably equip the two **Crucifixes** you have as well, and probably a combination **Zodiac** and **Cosmic Bracelet** on the third person. Check out the status effects of the enemies below to see why.

steps.description:
1. After the quick scene, you'll regain control as **Alice**.
2. Before entering the house, head over to the left and examine the ground below the barrels to find the **Oracle Earrings**.
3. Go inside the house and use the **Save Point** if you wish, then examine the grandfather clock to your left to find a **Crank**.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: **Alice** must be in your party to be able to do anything here.

steps.description:
- Go into the room to the upper-right of the **Save Point** and examine the table just below you as you enter for a **Lottery Ticket**.
- Go up the stairs to your upper-left and through the doorway here to be at a fountain.
- Go up to the left side of it and examine it to have to do a **Push Ring**.
- When you complete it successfully, you'll receive the **Storeroom Key**.

1. Head back outside of the house and examine the western door near where you found the **Oracle Earrings**.
2. With the key, you can now go through here, so do so, then examine the generator above you to use the **Crank** to start it.
3. To your upper-right, you should see some shovels and a bucket; examine the bucket to find a **Silver Hand**.
4. Climb down the ladder to your right, then check at the very bottom of the screen; where you see the two bottles and the glass, you'll find a **Slide** plate.

1. Make your way back into the other side of the house, then go up the stairs to the left of the **Save Point** and into the room here.
2. Examine the projector on the table to the right to use the **Slide**, where you'll see that the picture projected was taken on **December 24**, or **1224**.

1. Go back downstairs and into the room to the right.
2. Examine the dial beside the fireplace, and you'll be able to enter a code.
3. Enter **1224**, then make your way back to the **Save Point**, making sure to both Save and recover, as we're taking on a boss next.

1. Go back outside, then through the storeroom, down the ladder, then down and right to the door here.
2. Go through it, then down the stairs to a large door that you can now open since the water has been drained.

1. Okay, be honest...
2. Did you jump when you first walked into the room to see the doll baby riding the rocking horse?
3. I played Resident Evil: Nemesis when I was a bit too young, so certain things catch me off guard...
In any case, before exploring too much, open the chest at the foot of the bed for a **Crucifix**. You should now have **three** of them!

notes.title: Note
notes.text: Take the time now to equip each party member with a **Crucifix**, or at least a **Zodiac** or **Rosewood Bracelet**.

steps.description: When you're ready, try to leave the room... *shudder*

items.text: She has several different spells that will increase her stats by 25-30%, so once she's done doing that, be very careful, as they went from very strong to deadly.
She WILL almost kill **Yuri** in one set of attacks once her attack is boosted, she's THAT strong!
**Alice** won't have time to do anything except **Arc** once **Orb Chaos** starts attacking.
Other than the boosting spells, **Orb Chaos** attacks normally for major damage, and uses a spell called Expression that can not only do pretty good damage, but can also Paralyze your entire party!
If you don't have those **Crucifixes** equipped, good luck winning, especially when she starts using Expression each turn, one after another.

Even though he may barely have enough SP to do it, have **Yuri** fuse into **Amon**, then have one of the girls use a **Pure Seed**/Root on him to give him some breathing room, then have him attack normally.
**Alice** should be casting **Arc** every round, and **Margarete** should be attacking normally every round, since both she and **Yuri** should have **Mind's Eyes** equipped.
Note: once the battle is over, you'll receive **Alice**'s best weapon, the **Holy Book-Flesh**.

steps.description: After the battle, make sure to equip **Alice**'s best weapon. That's it for here, so head back out onto the **World Map**.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: You can return here later if you like, but you have to make sure **Alice** is in your party.

steps.description:
1. If you like, you can return to **Prague** and go to the bar.
2. There's an interesting detail on the floor where **Ewan** was standing if you want to check that out.
3. Otherwise, we're finished and ready for the next quest.
